0022600224.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 3-3 on the road, 11th in the East, on a W1 streak) visit the Utah Jazz (1-10, 1-5 at home, 15th in the West, on a nine-game losing streak). Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva is day-to-day with a calf strain. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), with Keyonte George (ankle sprain) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) listed as day-to-day, and the Magic won the last meeting 120-117 in Orlando on February 7, 2026, after taking both games of the 2025-26 season series.
